steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1')

steps.name: pick-a-room
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const r = s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; window.__roomId = r.id; window.__roomName = r.name; window.__roomsBefore = s.floorPlan.rooms.length; window.__wallsBefore = s.floorPlan.walls.length; s.setPlanSelection({ type: 'room', id: r.id }); return r.id })()

steps.name: expand-panel
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Expand properties"]'); if (b) b.click(); return !!b })()

steps.name: assert-button-present
steps.eval: (() => { const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Duplicate room'); if (btns.length !== 1) throw new Error('expected 1 Duplicate room button, got ' + btns.length); window.__dupBtnOk = true; return true })()

steps.name: click-duplicate
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Duplicate room'); b.scrollIntoView(); b.click(); return true })()

steps.name: assert-clone
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const sel = s.planSelection; const copy = s.floorPlan.rooms.find(r => r.id === sel.id); const ok = { rooms: s.floorPlan.rooms.length, roomsBefore: window.__roomsBefore, wallsBefore: window.__wallsBefore, wallsNow: s.floorPlan.walls.length, copyName: copy && copy.name, copyOrigin: copy && copy.origin, selectedNew: sel.type === 'room' && sel.id !== window.__roomId }; window.__dupResult = ok; if (!ok.selectedNew) throw new Error('copy not selected'); if (s.floorPlan.rooms.length !== window.__roomsBefore + 1) throw new Error('room count wrong'); return ok })()
